newsitem.title: GERMANY: Weekly Germany-Uzbekistan freighter starts Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Germany-Uzbekistan freighter starts Jan 8.

text.p: A weekly Germany to Uzbekistan freighter service will be launched on January 8, charter company Air Cargo Logistic GmbH (ACL) said.
The Iluyshin 76 freighter will have a maximum payload of 42 tonnes on the Hahn airport-Tashkent route, an ACL statement said.
The service will be flown by Central Asian Logistics, a joint venture between ACL and Avialeasing Aviation Company, a private Uzbek airline.
Avialeasing has a 6,500 square metres customs warehouse in Tashkent and a fleet including three Iluyshin 76s all built since 1993 and two Tupolev 154s, the ACL statement said.
The airline would manage freight distribution from Tashkent to 11 Uzbek destinations, Tbilisi, Dushanbe, Ashkabad and other central Asian destinations, it added.
